title: Disclaimer
content:
Stock Anatomy is for information and education only. Nothing on this site is investment advice.

Not a recommendation

Posts on this site describe which companies make which parts, based on public information. Mentioning a company, its stock ticker, or figures about its sales is not a recommendation to buy, sell or hold any security. We do not publish target prices or buy/sell ratings.

Do your own research

Investing in stocks involves risk, including the loss of your principal. Any decision you make based on this site is your own responsibility. Before investing, check the original sources and, where appropriate, consult a licensed financial professional.

Accuracy of information

  • We rely on public sources: company filings, official announcements, news reports and published analyst reports. These sources can be incomplete or wrong, and supply relationships change over time.
  • Figures credited to analysts or news outlets are their estimates, not ours, and actual results may differ.
  • Every post shows a "last checked" date. Information may have changed after that date.
  • Each company mention carries an evidence label (Filing, Announced, Reported or Estimated). See the About page for what each label means.

Images and videos

Teardown images and videos on this site are reconstructions created from public information. They are not photographs of an actual disassembly and may differ from the real product.

Affiliations

We are not paid by, and do not act on behalf of, any company we write about. This site may display advertising through Google AdSense; advertisers do not influence what we write.

Corrections

If you find an error, please leave a comment on the post. We correct the post itself and update its "last checked" date.

Last updated: September 26, 2026
